<function name="GetInvInertia" parent="PhysObj" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns 1 divided by the angular inertia. See <page>PhysObj:GetInertia</page></description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="invAngularInertia" type="Vector">The inverted angular inertia
			<warning>Returns `[0, 0, 0]` on frozen physics objects.</warning>
		</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
